message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout just as I was settling in with a cozy movie night. I remembered to grab my trusty power bank and a couple of flashlights before the lights went out completely. It turned into a fun evening of board games by flashlight, and I felt pretty proud for being prepared. It's amazing how a little bit of planning can turn a potential hassle into a memorable night! Have you had any unexpected moments like that?
